residence.en: The ambassador's official residence stands near the government district.
residence.zh: 大使的官邸位於政府區附近。

resident.en: Each resident received a notice about the neighborhood meeting.
resident.zh: 每位居民都收到一份關於社區會議的通知。

residential.en: The bus route passes through several quiet residential areas.
residential.zh: 這條公車路線會經過幾個安靜的住宅區。

resign.en: The manager decided to resign after completing the major project.
resign.zh: 經理在完成重大專案後決定辭職。

resignation.en: Her resignation surprised several members of the organization.
resignation.zh: 她的辭職讓組織中的幾位成員感到意外。

resistance.en: The experiment measures air resistance at different speeds.
resistance.zh: 這項實驗測量不同速度下的空氣阻力。

resistant.en: This material is resistant to water under normal conditions.
resistant.zh: 這種材料在一般情況下具有防水性。

resolution.en: The image has enough resolution to show small details clearly.
resolution.zh: 這張影像有足夠解析度，可以清楚顯示小細節。

resort.en: The family stayed at a mountain resort during the holiday.
resort.zh: 這個家庭假期住在一間山區度假村。

respectable.en: She earned a respectable score after months of careful preparation.
respectable.zh: 經過數月認真準備後，她取得相當不錯的成績。

respectful.en: The discussion remained respectful even when opinions strongly differed.
respectful.zh: 即使意見差異很大，討論仍保持尊重。

respondent.en: Each survey respondent answered the same set of questions.
respondent.zh: 每位問卷受訪者都回答同一組問題。

restoration.en: The restoration of the old theater took nearly two years.
restoration.zh: 這座老劇院的修復工程花了將近兩年。

restraint.en: The debate required patience and restraint from both sides.
restraint.zh: 這場辯論需要雙方都保持耐心與克制。

restriction.en: The park introduced a temporary restriction during the repair work.
restriction.zh: 公園在維修期間實施一項臨時限制。

restroom.en: The nearest restroom is beside the main entrance.
restroom.zh: 最近的洗手間就在主要入口旁。

resume.en: Classes will resume after the public holiday ends.
resume.zh: 國定假日結束後將恢復上課。

retail.en: The report compares retail sales across several shopping districts.
retail.zh: 這份報告比較數個商圈的零售銷售。

retreat.en: The team held a weekend retreat to plan next year's activities.
retreat.zh: 團隊舉辦週末研習活動，規劃明年的行程。

retrieve.en: Students can retrieve saved files from the school computer system.
retrieve.zh: 學生可以從學校電腦系統取回已儲存的檔案。

reunion.en: Former classmates organized a reunion at their old school.
reunion.zh: 昔日同學在母校舉辦了一場同學會。

revelation.en: The final chapter contains a surprising revelation about the main character.
revelation.zh: 最後一章揭露了關於主角的一個驚人真相。

revenge.en: The novel suggests that revenge can keep a conflict going longer.
revenge.zh: 小說暗示報復可能讓衝突延續更久。

revenue.en: Ticket sales provide an important source of revenue for the museum.
revenue.zh: 門票收入是博物館的重要收入來源。

reverse.en: Press this button to reverse the direction of the animation.
reverse.zh: 按下這個按鈕可以反轉動畫方向。

revival.en: The town saw a revival of interest in traditional crafts.
revival.zh: 這個城鎮重新興起對傳統工藝的興趣。

revive.en: The festival helped revive an old local tradition.
revive.zh: 這場節慶幫助復興一項古老的地方傳統。

revolt.en: The history lesson examines the causes of a nineteenth-century revolt.
revolt.zh: 歷史課探討一場十九世紀起義的成因。

revolution.en: The industrial revolution changed production, transportation, and daily life.
revolution.zh: 工業革命改變了生產、交通與日常生活。

revolutionary.en: The invention introduced a revolutionary way to store information.
revolutionary.zh: 這項發明帶來一種革命性的資訊儲存方式。

revolve.en: Several planets revolve around the star in this model.
revolve.zh: 在這個模型中，數顆行星繞著恆星運行。

rhetoric.en: The class analyzed the rhetoric used in a historical speech.
rhetoric.zh: 班上分析了一篇歷史演說中使用的修辭。

rhyme.en: The poem uses rhyme to make several lines more memorable.
rhyme.zh: 這首詩運用押韻讓幾行文字更容易記住。

rhythm.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the performance.
rhythm.zh: 鼓手在整場表演中維持穩定節奏。

rib.en: The biology model shows the position of each rib clearly.
rib.zh: 生物模型清楚顯示每根肋骨的位置。

ribbon.en: She tied a blue ribbon around the gift box.
ribbon.zh: 她在禮物盒上綁了一條藍色緞帶。

riches.en: The story warns that riches do not guarantee lasting happiness.
riches.zh: 故事提醒財富並不能保證長久的幸福。

rid.en: The editor helped rid the paragraph of repeated phrases.
rid.zh: 編輯幫忙刪除段落中重複的片語。

riddle.en: The teacher began class with a short logic riddle.
riddle.zh: 老師用一則簡短的邏輯謎題開始上課。

ridge.en: The hikers followed the ridge until sunset approached.
ridge.zh: 健行者沿著山脊前進，直到接近日落。

ridiculous.en: The rumor sounded ridiculous after the facts became clear.
ridiculous.zh: 事實釐清後，那則謠言聽起來很荒謬。

rob.en: The novel describes a plan to rob a bank but gives no practical details.
rob.zh: 小說描述一個搶銀行的計畫，但沒有提供實際做法細節。

robber.en: The detective story follows the search for a robber after the crime.
robber.zh: 這則偵探故事描述犯罪後追查一名搶匪的過程。

robbery.en: The news report discussed the robbery without showing graphic scenes.
robbery.zh: 新聞報導討論那起搶案，但沒有呈現血腥畫面。

ruthless.en: The novel portrays the ruler as ruthless and unwilling to compromise.
ruthless.zh: 小說把那位統治者描寫成冷酷且不願妥協。

savage.en: The old text uses savage as a dated and potentially offensive term.
savage.zh: 這篇舊文本把 savage 當作一個過時且可能冒犯人的詞。

scar.en: The tree trunk still has a scar from an old storm.
scar.zh: 樹幹上仍留有多年前暴風雨造成的痕跡。

scoop.en: The reporter published a major scoop before the other newspapers.
scoop.zh: 那名記者比其他報紙更早刊出一則重大獨家新聞。

scooter.en: She parked her scooter beside the bicycle rack.
scooter.zh: 她把機車停在腳踏車架旁。

scout.en: A scout recorded bird species during the nature activity.
scout.zh: 一名童軍在自然活動中記錄鳥類種類。
